_how: Wonder's brain, read by /backstage/brain/mind.js. Same format as /backstage/marquez/brain.json (see its _how): topics with match phrases and replies, replies as lines or lists of lines or {"go": "nodeId"} into dialogue.json, conditions (has, had, lost, never, flag, seen, unseen, named, after), 'do': 'show' / 'tell', and placeholders {name} {kills} {item} {1}. Line extras for Wonder: "fx": "stars" lights up the void. 'loose': '*' means every code in dialogue.json 'finds' (4 letters or more) also works inside a sentence, except the 'chatWords' (everyday words) and the item names (naming a thing shows it only if you have it). So 'do you like minecraft' gets his Minecraft reaction, 'what about todd' gets his TODD one, and so on.
_note: Drafted by Claude from Wonder's dialogue.json and the lore so far; rewrite freely. About 80% caps. He dodges the wolf, how he got out of Varandia, and what he was god of.
